description: The effectful shell promises four bounded PostgREST reads but defines neither pagination nor an explicit completeness limit. A tenant with more eligible rows than the service response cap can be silently truncated, producing a score that violates the requirement to aggregate every eligible outcome in the period.

evidence.snippet: Four bounded PostgREST reads query lm_score_outcomes with exact uid, organ, occurred_at.gte, and occurred_at.lt filters.
